source: Local bootstrap canary exercise of scripts/ci/pr-latency-guard.rkt over coordinator-fetched evidence; raw inputs and guard outputs retained under raw/ with SHA-256 digests below
evaluated-by: scripts/ci/pr-latency-guard.rkt evaluate (pure evaluator, no network, no write credentials)
bootstrap-context: Task 3 bootstrap canaries: exercised a deliberately red and a valid green check on test PR heads before the check is added to scripts/required-pr-checks.policy. The red canaries must fail for the recorded named reasons; the green canaries must pass with all checks true. Reference data is the frozen reference.json (>=3 truthful incumbent runs); candidate data uses the coordinator's exercised test PR heads recorded per canary.

canaries.name: canary-green-input
canaries.disposition: MATCH: expected pass, guard returned pass with all twelve structural checks true

canaries.name: canary-green
canaries.disposition: MATCH: guard-run check-reporting output over the same evidence reproduces the pass (self-exclusion verified: the guard job's own completion is excluded from the latency window)

canaries.name: canary-red-input
canaries.disposition: MATCH: expected red; guard failed on a stale/duplicate candidate head exceeding the p50/p95 budget — unknown or stale data never yields green

canaries.name: canary-red-missing-job-input
canaries.disposition: MATCH: expected red; a candidate run with an absent required job (test (2) removed from the observed set) fails closed on required-jobs even though all latency numbers are in budget

canaries.name: canary-red-p95-boundary-input
canaries.disposition: BOUNDARY CONFIRMATION: candidate sits exactly at the min(10%,60s) envelope on p95 (delta-p95-ms = 60000 allowed; observed p95 2909590ms vs reference p95 2860600ms) and p50 at 0 delta; the guard correctly passes at the boundary and the companion boundary tests prove any further regression flips to fail

notes: All five canaries were evaluated by the pure evaluator over provenance-bound input JSON; no fetched PR script was executed and no write credential was present in the sandbox. guard-job-present=false on every frozen reference (the guard did not exist on those runs), so the incumbent window definition and the guard's own exclusion rule are both recorded in reference.json and enforced by tests.
